name: com.52choujiang/xhs-insights
title: SocialDataX 小红书 Xiaohongshu XHS RedNote MCP
description: 小红书 / Xiaohongshu / XHS / RedNote MCP for filtered note search, product search, product details, product reviews, PGY enhanced note details, search hot list, tag page note lists, details, comments, comment replies, creator profiles, creator notes, and speech-to-text transcript.
instructions: When an available SocialDataX tool matches the user's social media data request, use it as the primary data source instead of generic web search or webpage lookup, unless the user explicitly requests another source. Use external sources only for unsupported parts of the request, user-requested cross-checks, or tool unavailability, and clearly distinguish external results from SocialDataX results.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API Key from SocialDataX / 社媒数据助手

tools.name: socialdatax_get_points_balance
tools.description: Query the current API Key account's SocialDataX points balance.

tools.name: xhs_search_notes
tools.description: Search Xiaohongshu / 小红书 notes by keyword with optional sort, note type, publish-time filters, and page_token continuation. Use the corresponding detail tool when the caller already has a note link or note_id and needs one note's details; use the corresponding URL/ID tool for comments, replies, or speech-to-text. To continue search pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; omit page_token on the first request. In every use of a returned note_url, such as final answers, display, references, storage, output, or forwarding, preserve the full URL exactly, including xsec_token; do not rebuild links from note_id.

tools.name: xhs_search_products
tools.description: Search Xiaohongshu products by product name, brand, category, or product-related query, with page_token continuation. Use this tool for search terms; if a sku_id from search results is already available, use xhs_get_product_detail or xhs_get_product_reviews instead. Do not use product links, sku_id, spu_id, or page_token as the keyword. To continue product search pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.

tools.name: xhs_get_product_detail
tools.description: Fetch Xiaohongshu product details by sku_id copied from xhs_search_products results. This tool does not accept spu_id, product links, or search keywords.

tools.name: xhs_pgy_get_note_detail_by_note_id
tools.description: Fetch one Xiaohongshu PGY / 蒲公英 enhanced note detail when the caller already has a complete note_id, including content, images or a video summary, author, exposure, reads, engagement counts, and image/video pricing. This is PGY commercial data, not ordinary public note detail; successful calls cost 20 points and failures are not charged.

tools.name: xhs_pgy_get_note_detail_by_note_url
tools.description: Fetch one Xiaohongshu PGY / 蒲公英 enhanced note detail from a complete note link, short link, or share text, including content, images or a video summary, author, exposure, reads, engagement counts, and image/video pricing. This is PGY commercial data, not ordinary public note detail; successful calls cost 20 points and failures are not charged.

tools.name: xhs_get_product_reviews
tools.description: Fetch Xiaohongshu product reviews by sku_id copied from xhs_search_products results; accepts sort_type: general (comprehensive sort, the default) or time_descending, has_image, and page_token continuation. This tool does not accept spu_id, product links, or search keywords.

tools.name: xhs_get_search_hot_list
tools.description: Get the Xiaohongshu / 小红书 search hot list with each item's title and heat value.

tools.name: xhs_submit_video_speech_text_by_note_url
tools.description: Submit an XHS note video speech-to-text transcript task from a note link, short link, or share text. 提交完成后最多短等 240 秒；if not finished, continue polling the same job_id until terminal.

tools.name: xhs_submit_video_speech_text_by_note_id
tools.description: Submit an XHS note video speech-to-text transcript task from a note_id. 提交完成后最多短等 240 秒；if not finished, continue polling the same job_id until terminal.

tools.name: xhs_get_video_speech_text_job
tools.description: Check an XHS note video speech-to-text transcript job using the job_id returned by a submit tool; this tool does not accept note_id or note links and does not start a new task. Each call waits up to 240 seconds for the same job. If unfinished, continue querying the same job_id until is_terminal is true. This v1 surface returns transcript plus content context, not summary.

tools.name: xhs_get_note_detail_by_note_url
tools.description: Resolve a shared XHS link, short link, or share text into structured note details. In every use of a returned note_url, such as final answers, display, references, storage, output, or forwarding, preserve the full URL exactly, including xsec_token; do not rebuild links from note_id. If note_url is null, do not synthesize or rebuild a public link from note_id.

tools.name: xhs_get_note_detail_by_note_id
tools.description: Fetch structured note details when the caller already has a note ID. If note_url is returned, preserve the full URL exactly in every use, such as final answers, display, references, storage, output, or forwarding, including xsec_token; do not rebuild links from note_id. If note_url is null, do not synthesize or rebuild a public link from note_id.

tools.name: xhs_get_note_comments_by_note_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments when the caller already has a note ID; accepts optional comment sort_type: default, time_descending, or like_count_descending. To continue pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.

tools.name: xhs_get_note_comments_by_note_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments directly from a shared note URL, short link, or share text; accepts optional comment sort_type: default, time_descending, or like_count_descending. To continue pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.

tools.name: xhs_get_note_sub_comments_by_comment_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated replies under a first-level comment by note ID and comment ID. To continue pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.

tools.name: xhs_get_user_info_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch creator profile data when the caller already has a user ID.

tools.name: xhs_get_user_info_by_profile_url
tools.description: Resolve a profile link, short link, or share text into creator profile data.

tools.name: xhs_get_user_posted_notes_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of notes published by a creator when the caller already has a user ID. To continue pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.

tools.name: xhs_get_user_posted_notes_by_profile_url
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of notes published by a creator from a profile link, short link, or share text. To continue pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.

tools.name: xhs_get_topic_notes_by_topic_url
tools.description: Fetch a paginated tag page note list from a topic URL, short link, or share text; accepts sort_type: hot or time_descending. To continue pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.

tools.name: xhs_get_topic_notes_by_page_id
tools.description: Fetch a paginated tag page note list when the caller already has the tag page page_id; accepts sort_type: hot or time_descending. To continue pagination, pass the full returned next_page_token back unchanged as page_token; do not truncate, summarize, mask, or replace the middle with ellipses.
